Specification: This specification models Lamport's Fast Mutual Exclusion algorithm for two classes of processes: a distinguished process 1 and a family of processes in 2..N. The file contains a PlusCal algorithm and its generated TLA+ translation, using shared variables x, y, and b together with per-process control state and failure flags to coordinate entry into a critical section. It specifies initialization, the step relation, weak fairness for both process classes, a mutual exclusion invariant stating that no two distinct processes are simultaneously in the critical section, and a liveness property asserting that infinitely often some process is in the critical section.

IF x # 1 THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![1] = "l8"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![1] = "cs"]
IF (j \leq N) THEN /\ ~b[j] /\ j' = j+1 /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![1] = "l9"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![1] = "l10"] /\ j' = j
IF y # 1 THEN /\ y = 0 /\ failed' = TRUE ELSE /\ TRUE /\ UNCHANGED failed
IF ~ failed THEN /\ TRUE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![1] = "l11"] /\ UNCHANGED failed ELSE /\ failed' = FALSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![1] = "start"]

IF y # self THEN /\ y = 0 /\ failed2' = [failed2 EXCEPT ![self] = TRUE] ELSE /\ TRUE /\ UNCHANGED failed2
IF ~ failed2[self] THEN /\ TRUE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "2l11"] /\ UNCHANGED failed2 ELSE /\ failed2' = [failed2 EXCEPT ![self] = FALSE] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "2start"]
